The '''scintil vine''' was a [[Flower/Legends|flowering]] [[Vine/Legends|vine]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], and one of the few to survive the damage done to the planet during the [[Ruusan campaign|battle]] there<ref name="TCSWE" /> between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].<ref name="Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>

At some point, Ruusan's residents discovered that when the vine's flowers were mixed with powdered [[tass root]] and dampened, a highly corrosive paste was formed that could destroy rock and metal.<ref name="TCSWE" /> In [[990 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the end of the [[Ruusan campaign]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'' dates the events of the novel, including [[Darovit]]'s sabotage, to ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later. Therefore, the sabotage must have occurred in [[990 BBY]].</ref> the hermit [[Darovit]] used the paste to sabotage the construction of a monument being built to honor [[Death/Legends|sacrifice]] of the Jedi who had fought in the battle.<ref name="Rule of Two" />

==Behind the scenes==
The scintil vine first appeared in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] as the first installment of ''[[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy]]''.<ref name="Rule of Two" />
